identity_provider_details.auth_configured_description: Users will now be able to authenticate via {name}.
identity_provider_details.metadata_file_info: Add a metadata file from your identity provider to configure in one step
identity_provider_details.sso_url_info: This is the URL to which Postman sends a SAML request to start the login sequence.
identity_provider_details.idp_issuer_info: This is the URI that uniquely identifies your SAML identity provider. SAML assertions sent to Postman must match this value exactly in the saml:Issuer attribute of SAML assertions.
identity_provider_details.x509_certificate_info: The authentication certificate issued by your identity provider.
identity_provider_details.relay_state_info: For IdP-initiated SSO, a Relay State must be included with the SAML response to ensure proper redirection after login.

service_provider_details.warning_sign_saml_enabling: When checked, you must add the certificate to your IdP.
service_provider_details.warning_sign_saml_disabling: When disabling signing SAML requests, you may also need to remove the certificate verification requirement from your IdP to avoid breaking your SSO integration.
service_provider_details.entity_id_info: This entity is the issuer in SAML requests generated by Postman, and is also the expected audience of any inbound SAML Responses.
service_provider_details.login_url_info: A shortcut URL to initiate Single Sign On.
service_provider_details.acs_url_info: The SAML Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) URL is the location to which the SAML assertion is sent with an HTTP POST call.
service_provider_details.download_encryption_cert_tooltip: Public key certificate used to digitally encrypt the SAML assertion.
service_provider_details.sign_saml_requests_info: If enabled, Postman will sign authentication requests sent to the identity provider. Download this certificate and upload it to your identity provider during setup so they can verify the signature.
service_provider_details.include_encryption_cert_info: Include the public key certificate used to digitally encrypt the SAML assertion in the metadata file.
service_provider_details.sign_saml_and_include_sign_cert: Sign SAML requests and include signing certificate
service_provider_details.sign_saml_and_include_sign_cert_info: Include the signing certificate in the metadata file that will be used to sign authentication requests sent to the identity provider.
service_provider_details.not_all_idps_support_metadata: Not all identity providers support uploading metadata files. For some IdPs, you may need to manually configure the service provider details and upload certificates separately.
service_provider_details.regenerate_cert_button: Generate new encryption and signing certificates
service_provider_details.regenerate_cert_button_tooltip: Generate new SAML signing and encryption certificates
service_provider_details.regenerate_cert_expiry: The certificates in use will expire in {days} days. Renewal is required.
service_provider_details.regenerate_cert_expiry_tomorrow: The certificates in use are expiring tomorrow. Renewal is required.
service_provider_details.regenerate_cert_expiry_unknown: The certificates in use require renewal.
service_provider_details.regenerate_cert_content: New certificates will replace your existing ones. You'll need to update your identity provider with the new certificates to keep authentication working.
service_provider_details.regenerate_cert_success_description: Your SAML certificates have been successfully regenerated. Remember to update your identity provider configuration.
service_provider_details.regenerate_cert_error_default: An error occurred while regenerating certificates. Please try again or contact support.
